outcome: maternal hemodynamic parameters (mean arterial pressure, heart rate, SpO2)
cohort: 117 women undergoing cesarean section at Zigong First People's Hospital between July 2021 and October 2022.
finding: Dexmedetomidine before anesthesia improved maternal hemodynamic stability, shortened sensory and motor block onset, extended block duration, and reduced maternal complications, without significantly impacting neonatal Apgar or NBNA scores.
